review_policy.opt_in: Pass --ordinary-saves and set ordinary_save to an approved ID in the scenario.
review_policy.resource_tree_sha256:
Hash the UTF-8 concatenation of '<file sha256>  <game-root-relative path>
' for all regular files under the game root, sorted by slash-separated relative path.
review_policy.evidence: Approve only a normal slot written by an identified producer and read in a separate process by the exact integration consumer, after staging only the archived slot. Verify the restored line and advancement to a different line. Staging alone is not load acceptance.

v401-pc-slot-0.reason: Historical reopen used a private executable and the entire isolated profile. No approved production save provenance or single-file reopen on an identified integration build.
